cwe_descriptions: CWE-74: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Output Used by a Downstream Component ('Injection') — The product constructs all or part of a command, data structure, or record using externally-influenced input from an upstream component, but it does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes special elements that could modify how it is parsed or interpreted when it is sent to a downstream component.

CWE-78: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection') — The product constructs all or part of an OS command using externally-influenced input from an upstream component, but it does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes special elements that could modify the intended OS command when it is sent to a downstream component.
